task.title: Survive your first day
task.shortdesc: Collect basic materials, craft essential tools, and secure shelter before nightfall.

context.p: In Survival with hostile mobs enabled, night is dangerous without light or shelter. Aim to have tools, food, and a safe place before dusk.

step.cmd: Punch a tree to collect logs. Open your inventory and craft logs into planks, then planks into sticks.
On a crafting table (four planks in a 2×2 grid in inventory, then place the table), craft a wooden pickaxe: three planks across the top row and two sticks down the middle column.
Mine stone with the pickaxe and craft a stone pickaxe, then a sword if you expect combat.
Gather coal or burn logs in a furnace to make charcoal for torches (stick below coal or charcoal).
Build a small enclosed shelter or dig into a hillside. Place torches inside so mobs do not spawn there.
Optional: craft a bed from three wool and three planks. Sleeping at night skips to dawn if no hostile mobs are nearby.

result.p: After the first night, expand your base, explore for better ores, and experiment with farming and animal breeding for steady food.
